Struct AuraBufferDesc

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Aura
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Describes a buffer resource, including its size, usage, and other properties that control how the buffer is created and used in graphics applications.

Parameters

sizeInBytes ulong

The size, in bytes, of the buffer to be described. Must be greater than zero.

usage BufferBindUsage

The intended binding usage for the buffer, such as vertex or index buffer. Defaults to VertexBuffer if not specified.

dynamic bool

A value indicating whether the buffer is intended for dynamic updates. Set to true for buffers that will be updated frequently; otherwise, false.

Field Value

EnableGrowth

If true, the buffer can grow in size if needed. This is useful for dynamic buffers that may need to accommodate varying amounts of data over time. When enabled, the buffer can automatically resize itself. Always call bind after uploading data when using this option, as resizing consists of creating a new buffer and copying the old data to it, which will unbind the buffer.

public bool EnableGrowth

Field Value

bool

IsDynamic

If true, this buffer will be considered dynamic, aka its data is going to be written once and read once before changing again. This allows the buffer to be optimized for this usage pattern, which can improve performance in certain scenarios, such as when frequently updating vertex data or other resources that require frequent modifications. Set this to false if the buffer is not going to be updated frequently, as it may allow for better performance in scenarios where the buffer data is static or infrequently modified.

public bool IsDynamic
